summary: The Community release is fully separate from Pro, and managed tenants use least-privilege database access.

fixes.title: Community edition runs as before
fixes.text: The public Community release no longer contains Pro code, and Community installations install, update and run as before. Tenant preparation works in Community.

fixes.title: Least-privilege database access on managed tenants
fixes.text: On a managed tenant, every update gives the job that pulls changes its own least-privilege database user and reports whether it still uses the database admin group.
